data.narrative:
OroraTech is a Series B space and aerospace company that has raised €38M+ to date. Valuation analysis relies on a peer-median approach across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), Varda Space Industries ($1.5B, Series C), Aalyria ($1.3B, Series B), and Skyryse ($1.1B, Series C).

The peer-median method yields an implied valuation of $1.5B, with the comparison set ranging from $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples is not applicable here, as OroraTech's revenue is not on file; the broader Space & Aerospace public universe (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trades at a 23.9x sector median P/S, but cannot be meaningfully applied without disclosed financials.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.3B to $1.7B, with a median of $1.5B, supported by a single quantitative method. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion in the peer set—driven by stage and maturity variance between Series B and Series C assets—and the absence of OroraTech's revenue metrics, which would enable cross-check via public multiples. The $8.0B Sierra Space outlier reflects later-stage positioning and likely material operational progress relative to OroraTech's current maturity.
